```python
def split_gpxs(xml: AnyStr) ->Iterable[str]:
    dom = mod_minidom.parseString(xml)
    gpx_node = _find_gpx_node(dom)
    
    if not gpx_node:
        return
    
    # Collect all track elements
    trk_elements = []
    for child_node in gpx_node.childNodes:
        if child_node.nodeName == 'trk':
            trk_elements.append(child_node)
    
    # For each track, create a new GPX document with just that track
    for trk_element in trk_elements:
        new_dom = mod_minidom.parseString(xml)
        new_gpx_node = _find_gpx_node(new_dom)
        
        # Remove all trk children from the new dom
        children_to_remove = [child for child in new_gpx_node.childNodes if child.nodeName == 'trk']
        for child in children_to_remove:
            new_gpx_node.removeChild(child)
        
        # Import and append the specific track element
        imported_trk = new_dom.importNode(trk_element, True)
        new_gpx_node.appendChild(imported_trk)
        
        yield new_dom.toxml()
```
